The following events took place in '''6 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*[[Pooja Naberrie/Legends|Pooja Naberrie]] replaced [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] as [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Chommell sector/Legends|sector]] at age twenty.<ref name="Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force real-life book">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>
*[[Loka Hask]] was expelled from the [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]].
*[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] graduated from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Carida Academy/Legends|Academy]] on [[Carida/Legends|Carida]].
*The ''[[Dominant]]'' was launched. {{Circa}}<ref name="TTaBSb">''[[The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook]]'' places this event almost a decade before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].</ref>
*[[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]] seized control of [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]].
*[[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] visited [[Trammis III/Legends|Trammis III]].<ref name="Mindharp of Sharu">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Mindharp of Sharu]]''</ref>
*[[Hoffner]], the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] in [[Jorj Car'das]]'s fleet, escapes a pair of [[Carrack-class light cruiser/Legends|''Carrack''-class light cruisers]] by making a blind [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] jump and emerges in the vicinity of the lost [[Katana fleet|''Katana'' fleet]]. The ''Katana'' fleet is unnoticed by all except Hoffner and [[Talon Karrde]], a navigator on the vessel, who both store the fleet's location for later use.<ref name="NEGC100">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref>
*[[Droid rebellion]].<ref name="swd:r">[[Star Wars: Droids (1995)|''Star Wars: Droids'' (1995)]]</ref>
*[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Soontir Fel/Legends|Soontir Fel]] ended his first [[tour of duty]] and began a second as a [[Captain/Legends|captain]].<ref name="RS25">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 25|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 25]]</ref><ref name="Soontir">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]'' places this event three years before the [[Battle of Nar Shaddaa (4 BBY)|Battle of Nar Shaddaa]] that takes place in [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]] according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref>
*End of the [[Reslian Purge]].<ref name="RS25" /><ref name="Soontir" />
*The Galactic Empire established a presence on [[Garos IV]]. Creation of the [[Committee of Seven for Garosian Unification]]. [[Dair Haslip]] joined the [[Raithal Academy/Legends|Raithal Academy]] as a spy.<ref name="TP">{{JournalCite|5|Turning Point (Charlene Newcomb)}}</ref>
*End of the [[Garosian civil war]].<ref name="TP" />
*Adoption of [[Alexandra Winger]] by [[Tork Winger|Tork]] and [[Sali Winger]].<ref name="TP" />
